units.source_text: 然而，他浅浅地感觉到，性欲是否可以分成两类。

en.t: Yet he had a vague feeling that sexual desire might be divided into two kinds.

units.source_text: 譬如，麦比乌斯圈那家伙，追求女朋友的时候，

en.t: For example, that Mobius strip fellow, when he was pursuing a girlfriend,

units.source_text: 肯定是从味觉和营养开始讲起的吧。

en.t: would surely start by talking about taste and nutrition.

units.source_text: ——说起来，肚子饿的人，只要有一般的食物就满足了，

en.t: Come to think of it, a hungry person is satisfied as long as there is ordinary food,

units.source_text: 神户牛肉啦，广岛牡蛎啦，对他们来说根本就不存在……

en.t: Kobe beef, Hiroshima oysters, and such things simply do not exist for them at all...

units.source_text: 大致上，填饱肚子得以保证后，

en.t: In general, only after the filling of the stomach has been assured,

units.source_text: 各种各样的味觉才开始具有意义……

en.t: do all the various senses of taste begin to have meaning...

units.source_text: 性欲也一样，首先是一般的性欲，

en.t: Sexual desire is the same: first there is ordinary sexual desire,

units.source_text: 接着才会发生多种多样的“性之滋味”……

en.t: and only afterward do the many different flavors of sex arise...

units.source_text: 性也不能一概而论，时间地点不同，要求也不一样，

en.t: Sex, too, cannot be discussed in sweeping terms; when time and place differ, the needs differ as well,

units.source_text: 有时需要维他命剂，有时则需要鳗鱼饭。

en.t: sometimes what is needed is a vitamin pill, and sometimes it is eel over rice.

units.source_text: 不管理论多么严谨，遗憾的是，

en.t: No matter how rigorous the theory was, unfortunately,

units.source_text: 他还没有一个女朋友接受这种理论，

en.t: he still had not had a single girlfriend accept that theory,

units.source_text: 把一般性欲，或固有之性，提供给他。

en.t: and offer him ordinary sexual desire, or an inherent sexuality.

units.source_text: 男的也好，女的也好，没有人会去听信理论。

en.t: Whether men or women, no one listens to and believes in theory.

units.source_text: 就连认真得有些傻乎乎的麦比乌斯圈也完全了解这等事，

en.t: Even the earnest, somewhat foolish Mobius strip understood such things perfectly well,

units.source_text: 一个劲儿地不停按响着空屋子的门铃。

en.t: and went on doggedly ringing the doorbell of an empty house.
